title: Ketu mahadasha: 7 years of letting go, explained | Ask Tota
description: Ketu mahadasha lasts 7 years and starts the dasha cycle for many people. Ketu's themes of detachment and insight, the nine antardashas, and how to read yours.
og_title: Ketu mahadasha, seven years of letting go
og_description: The headless node, the planet of detachment, insight and endings. Seven years, nine sub-periods, and why Ketu periods are about subtraction.
h1: ketu mahadasha is seven years of subtraction, and subtraction is not loss
dek: ketu is rahu's other half: the tail without a head, the planet of detachment, insight, past skills and spiritual turning. its seven years are often described as a period of things falling away, which sounds bleak until u notice what makes room.

llms_desc: Ketu mahadasha in Vimshottari: 7 years, why Ketu signifies detachment, insight, moksha and past-life skills, why it gives results through its sign lord, the nine antardashas and their lengths, themes commonly reported, remedies and myths.

faq.a: 7 years. it is the first period in the vimshottari sequence and comes before venus's 20 years. people born with the moon in ashwini, magha or mula start life in ketu mahadasha.

not by default. ketu signifies detachment, insight and spirituality, so its period often involves letting go of things. whether that feels like loss or clarity depends on ketu's house, its sign lord and the planets with it.

faq.q: what are the effects of ketu mahadasha?
faq.a: commonly reported themes are detachment from old goals or identities, interest in spirituality or research, sudden endings, deep focus on a narrow skill, and less interest in worldly status. ketu's house shows where these themes land.

faq.q: what is the first antardasha in ketu mahadasha?
faq.a: ketu-ketu, about 4 months 27 days. then venus, sun, moon, mars, rahu, jupiter, saturn and mercury.

faq.q: why does ketu give results like its sign lord?
faq.a: like rahu, ketu is a lunar node, not a body, and owns no sign by classical agreement. it is said to act like the lord of the sign it occupies and like the planets it joins, often summarised as ketu acting like mars.

faq.q: which nakshatras start life in ketu mahadasha?
faq.a: ashwini, magha and mula, the three nakshatras ruled by ketu. a moon in any of them means the first dasha of life is ketu's, with whatever portion remained at birth.

faq.q: is ketu mahadasha good for spirituality?
faq.a: ketu is the natural karaka of moksha, liberation, so spiritual interest is one of its most consistent themes. many people describe it as the period they started meditating, studying philosophy or simplifying their life.

faq.q: is ketu mahadasha good for career?
faq.a: it can suit research, technical specialisation, healing, coding, occult or spiritual work, and anything that rewards deep focus over public visibility. ambition for status often drops, which can feel unsettling.

the longest sub-period in ketu's dasha at 1 year 2 months. it often brings a contrast: ketu's detachment meeting venus's appetite for beauty and relationships, which some people experience as a sudden reawakening.

faq.q: what are the remedies for ketu mahadasha?
faq.a: traditional remedies include ganesha worship, ketu mantras, meditation, donating to the needy, feeding dogs in some traditions, and keeping a regular spiritual practice. cat's eye is the traditional stone, worn only after careful chart review.
venus mahadasha, the longest at 20 years. the shift from ketu's austerity to venus's enjoyment is one of the sharpest tonal changes in the cycle.

faq.q: does ketu mahadasha cause health problems?
faq.a: traditional texts link ketu with sudden or hard to diagnose conditions, but no chart placement is a medical diagnosis. any health concern needs a doctor, not a dasha reading.
